semantic.justification: Original finite wall-clock and elapsed-time output with actual tools::Time::GetClock, real compiled tokens and current calendar names. Preserves native uint widths, precision7 input-line minimum, duration uint32 limit, distinct truncation/rounding, sign rules, AM/PM and original fill return. Complete native-number modifiers and date/datetime output remain unfinished; scalar GetClock native comparison does not certify full format display/UNO ABI. Shared original integer-padding and fractional-second responsibilities are now exported under original method names for the date/datetime fragment. Their admitted incomplete-native metadata behavior and source rounding remain unchanged. Original integer padding and clock-output temporary owners now begin cleanup scopes before later buffer constructors. Only constructed buffers are disposed; successful source formatting and original C allocation guards remain unchanged. Normal-output/early-constructor allocation tests are bounded, not full native OOM certification. Original ImpGetNatNumString now accepts actual metadata/value/minimum/native wrapper arguments and performs source padding before original impTransliterate. TIME converts each integer field; fractions, separators, literals and elapsed minus retain original untranslated placement. Supersedes the former incomplete-native-only producer limitation for modes0..11. Mode12 remains unported. Corrects the preceding block's omitted source ImpGetFractionOfSecondString conversion: fractional-second buffers are transliterated in both source branches, with input-line minimum digits updating the decimal counter only after conversion. Normal display retains its requested counter and original returned-buffer-length bound, including Hebrew conversion truncation. The prior statement that fractional digits remain ASCII was a local implementation error, not an upstream contract. Source buffer/scanner/native wrapper owners remain actual; mode12 and full native wrapper ABI are not claimed.
